fields.label: Enable Xero Synchronization
fields.description: Master switch to enable or disable all Xero sync features.

fields.label: Connection Status
fields.description: Indicates if the connection to Xero is currently active (based on last check).

fields.label: Directional Sync Control
fields.description: Control sync direction at platform level. These settings override entity-specific toggles.

fields.label: Enable Sync TO Xero (ERPNext → Xero)
fields.description: Master toggle for ALL outbound syncs from ERPNext to Xero. When disabled, no data will be written to Xero regardless of entity-specific settings.

fields.label: Enable Sync FROM Xero (Xero → ERPNext)
fields.description: Master toggle for ALL inbound syncs from Xero to ERPNext. When disabled, no data will be read from Xero regardless of entity-specific settings.

fields.label: Directional Sync Warning
fields.options: Important: Directional toggles provide platform-level control. Disabling 'Sync TO Xero' will prevent ALL writes to Xero, even if entity-specific toggles are enabled. Use this to safeguard against accidental data writes.

fields.label: Redirect URL
fields.description: OAuth2 redirect URL configured in your Xero app (e.g., https://yoursite.com/api/method/xero.utils.xero_client.handle_oauth_callback)

fields.label: Sync Journal Entries
fields.description: Enable syncing of submitted Journal Entries to Xero Manual Journals.

fields.label: Sync Items/Products
fields.description: Enable syncing of Items to Xero Products & Services.

fields.label: Sync Standalone Payments
fields.description: Enable syncing of submitted Payment Entries (not linked to synced invoices) to Xero Payments.

fields.label: Sync Credit Notes
fields.description: Enable syncing of submitted Credit Notes to Xero Credit Notes.

fields.label: Sync Quotes/Quotations
fields.description: Enable syncing of submitted Quotations to Xero Quotes.

fields.label: Sync Tracking Categories
fields.description: Enable syncing of Xero Tracking Categories to ERPNext Cost Centers and Projects.

fields.label: Sync Financial Reports
fields.description: Enable syncing of financial reports (Trial Balance, P&L, Balance Sheet) from Xero.

fields.label: Sync Bank Transactions
fields.description: Enable syncing of Bank Transactions between ERPNext and Xero.

fields.label: Webhook Signing Secret
fields.description: Optional: Provide a secret key to verify webhook signatures from Xero.

fields.label: Create Payment Entry in ERPNext when Invoice is Paid in Xero
fields.description: If checked, a Payment Entry will be automatically created when a linked invoice's payment is detected via scheduled sync or webhook.

fields.label: Default Bank Account for Payments
fields.description: Select the default Bank or Cash account to use in automatically created Payment Entries.

fields.label: Log Retention Days
fields.description: Number of days to retain Xero sync logs before automatic cleanup.

fields.label: Max Retry Attempts
fields.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for rate-limited API requests (default: 5).

fields.label: API Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Timeout in seconds for Xero API requests (default: 30).

fields.label: Enable Rate Limit Tracking
fields.description: Track API rate limit usage and log when limits are hit.

fields.label: Backoff Base (seconds)
fields.description: Base delay in seconds for exponential backoff (default: 2). Formula: base^retry_count.

fields.label: Max Backoff Delay (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum delay in seconds between retry attempts (default: 60).
